headline: Colt45Johnson Scores 225.68, butterygoop Finally Loses, and the Two 9-1 Teams Meet Next
dek: Inside: the highest score of the season and the biggest week 10 win on record, BROCKSTARxD handing butterygoop his first loss, triccster's season high to hold the 6 seed, Colt45Johnson's trade for Ashton Jeanty, and the bracket if the season ended today.
lead:
Colt45Johnson scored 225.68 against Wallner, the highest score of the season in this league, and won by 86.78. Both numbers are week 10 records here, and both beat his own marks from the same game against the same opponent last year, 197.30 and 67.56. Jahmyr Gibbs scored 44.2 and Dak Prescott 35.42.

The league's last unbeaten team went down. BROCKSTARxD beat butterygoop 161.42 to 143.48 behind Christian McCaffrey's 46.3, the best game by any player in the league this week, and butterygoop is 9-1 with Colt45Johnson. They play each other in week 11.

Monday night flipped nothing. Below the top four, Wallner, triccster and DMsourbeer are all 5-5 for the last two spots.

managers.text: Beat Wallner 225.68 to 138.90 (see the lead), with Chuba Hubbard (34.2) behind Gibbs and Prescott and 1.00 left on the bench. Eight straight wins, and the only teams to beat the weekly median in all ten weeks are his and butterygoop's. Before the games he sent his 2027 first-round pick to brettmn13 for Ashton Jeanty, who started for 10.4. His one previous 9-1 start, in 2024, won the title.
managers.next: Week 11: butterygoop, the game of the week, for the 1 seed. Colt45Johnson leads the series 3-2, butterygoop won the last meeting, and Colt45Johnson is at 43%.

managers.text: Lost 161.42 to 143.48 to BROCKSTARxD, his first loss of the season, while still scoring above the median. Nico Collins (24.4), Josh Allen (23.34) and C.J. His one previous 9-1 start, in 2023, reached the final. Williams and Drake London are off in week 11.
managers.next: Week 11: Colt45Johnson. butterygoop is a 57% favorite.

managers.text: Beat brettmn13 148.76 to 113.66 behind George Pickens (43.5), Matthew Stafford (20.76) and DJ Moore (19.4), with 0.90 left on the bench. Three straight wins, and 7-3 is his best start through week 10 in this league, a win better than 2023 and 2025. 96% for the playoffs. Stafford, Quinshon Judkins, Denzel Boston and Kyle Pitts are off in week 11, four pieces to replace.
managers.next: Week 11: Wallner. TuanonStan leads the series 4-2 and is at 34%.

managers.text: Beat Thnu 129.08 to 80.34 behind Trevor Lawrence (27.78), Bhayshul Tuten (20.3) and Bijan Robinson (17.7). Justin Herbert had 16.26 on the bench and Corey Kiner started for 2.5. Four straight wins in his first season have him at 99% for the playoffs. Wan'Dale Robinson went on injured reserve on Tuesday and will miss at least four games.

items.text: Colt45Johnson got Ashton Jeanty from brettmn13 for his 2027 first-round pick. Jeanty started right away and scored 10.4 in the 225.68 game.

trends.title: What ten weeks means here
trends.text: All 11 teams in league history that were 7-3 or better after ten weeks made the playoffs. 6-4 teams made it 8 of 10 and 5-5 teams 5 of 6, and none of the 21 teams at 4-6 or worse got in.

trends.title: Scoring
trends.text: Week 10 averaged 139.1 a team, the second-highest week of the season after week 4 (139.7), and up from 119.5 in week 9.

trends.title: Lineup audit
trends.text: Starters who did not play this season: Jbird531 4, Thnu 3, TuanonStan 2, YoungBuck04 2, brettmn13 1 and Wallner 1, everyone else none. Two games would have gone the other way with the best bench player in each slot: TuanonStan's week 2 loss to HillBillyWorm and Jbird531's week 7 loss to Wallner.

features.label: Position groups
features.title: What each spot has actually produced
features.dek: Two different questions, and with twenty bench spots they are a long way apart. From the lineup is what a manager has banked at that spot over ten weeks, with the two flexes and the superflex counting toward whichever position filled them. On paper is every point the roster as it sits today has scored this season, including points scored for a previous owner. Both are scored this league's way, so the tight end numbers run high.

blocks.text: Colt45Johnson is first at quarterback and first at running back on both measures, 730 on paper and 463 from the lineup at one, 722 and 503 at the other. Nobody else in this league tops a position on both counts. The 9-1 and the 225.68 are the roster, not a hot streak.

The receiver picture flips completely between the two columns. On paper the top three sit inside 30 points, HillBillyWorm 851, Colt45Johnson 825, butterygoop 821. From the lineup it reads TuanonStan 696, butterygoop 642, Colt45Johnson 600, and HillBillyWorm falls to fourth on 538. Some 313 points of the best receiver room in the league have never been started.

brettmn13 is last at both receiver and tight end from the lineup, 269 and 92, and second in the entire league at running back on 490. That is not a bare roster, it is a roster with one position carrying the whole thing.

Through week 10, from Sleeper box scores. From the lineup counts only players actually started that week. On paper counts every point the current roster has scored this season, whoever owned the player at the time.

features.label: The bye crunch
features.title: Six teams are off, and it lands very unevenly
features.dek: Atlanta, Cleveland, Green Bay, the Rams, New England and Seattle. Roster depth makes a headcount meaningless here, so this is every rostered player on a bye team ranked by what he has scored this season.

rows: Puka Nacua 173, Matthew Stafford 172, Quinshon Judkins 108, Kyle Pitts 92
Christian Watson 183, Tucker Kraft 111, Davante Adams 102

blocks.text: The two 7-3 teams are the two worst hit. TuanonStan loses the most in the league, 576 points across ten players, and it falls in the week he plays Wallner, the team directly behind him and the least affected side in the league by a distance: three players and 12 points.

The one-seed game is not clean either. Colt45Johnson loses 341, nearly all of it Jaxon Smith-Njigba on his own, and butterygoop loses 261, mostly Drake London and Kyren Williams. Both carry that into Sunday. Thnu takes the heaviest toll per player anywhere: six off and 428 points between them.
